🎥🎬: X-Men ’97 (2024–present)

Following the loss of Professor Xavier, the X-Men struggle to carry on his dream of peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants. As old enemies return and new global threats emerge, the team must unite while dealing with grief, betrayal, and growing anti-mutant hatred.

Led by Cyclops, the X-Men face devastating battles that test their ideals and relationships like never before. With shocking twists, emotional sacrifices, and unforgettable action, the series continues the beloved 1990s animated saga while raising the stakes for every mutant.
